info.title: tela REST API
info.summary: HTTP API of tela, a self-hostable markdown-native team wiki.
info.description:
Machine-readable description of the HTTP API behind [tela](https://telawiki.com), an open-source markdown-native team wiki with a built-in MCP server.

## Stability

**`/api/*` is an internal API.** It powers tela's own React frontend and carries no version prefix; routes and shapes may change between releases without notice. `GET /api/health` and `GET /api/version` are the only routes with a stability promise.

**The stable integration surface is the MCP server** at `POST /api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP; OAuth 2.1 via the connector flow, or a personal access token as a bearer). Its tool schema is versioned and is the intended API for agents and third-party tools. Discovery metadata: `/.well-known/mcp.json` and `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`. The MCP transport is deliberately **not** described here — it speaks JSON-RPC over one endpoint, which OpenAPI cannot usefully model.

This document exists so an integrator, a crawler, or an agent directory can see what the HTTP surface actually is instead of guessing. Build against MCP where you can.

## Coverage

Described: meta, authentication, personal access tokens, spaces, pages (CRUD, move, revisions, backlinks, markdown export), search (lexical and semantic), comments, attachments, share links (management and the public token API), the no-login public-space read API, and feedback.

Deliberately omitted (real routes, not described): instance administration (`/api/admin/*`), organizations, groups, members and invitations, billing and licensing, Atlas documentation runs (`/api/atlas/*`), generative AI (`/api/rag/ask`, `/api/rag/draft`, summaries), notifications, digests, decks and sheets, the WebDAV sync surface (`/dav/`), the Yjs collaboration websocket (`/ws/`), Prometheus metrics, and OG/social-card rendering. They are internal, operator-only, or not HTTP-shaped.

Also not here: **section-level page patching**. The heading-path patch (`patch_page`) exists only as an MCP tool; over REST you read `page.body`, edit it, and `PATCH` the whole body back.

## Authentication

Two credentials, checked in that order:

1. `Authorization: Bearer tela_pat_<43 chars>` — a personal access token (Settings -> API keys, or `POST /api/api_keys`). If the header is present it is used; a bad token is `401` and never falls back to the cookie.
2. `Cookie: tela_session` — the browser session set by `POST /api/auth/login`.

A token carries a **scope**: `read` permits `GET`/`HEAD` only, `write` and `admin` permit any method. A scope violation is `403 api_key_scope`, written by middleware before the handler runs. `POST /api/feedback` is the single carve-out — any scope may call it.

A token may also be **pinned to one space** (`space_id`). Endpoints that resolve a target space then refuse other spaces with `403 api_key_space_scope`; endpoints that list across spaces silently narrow to the pinned one.

Within a space, roles are `owner > editor > viewer`; `editor+` is required to write. Note two asymmetries: reading **comments** and reading **revisions** both require `editor+`, not `viewer`.

Endpoints marked with an empty `security` need no credential: they self-authenticate on a token in the path, a signature, or a space published to the open web.

## Errors

Every JSON error is `{"error": "<human message>", "code": "<machine code>"}`. Key on `code`. `403 forbidden` doubles as "not found" on page and space reads — a missing object and an inaccessible one are deliberately indistinguishable, so ids cannot be enumerated.

## Dates

Timestamps are `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"` in UTC (no offset, no `Z`) unless a field says otherwise. This is a carry-over from tela's SQLite era and is stable.

servers.description: The instance serving this document. A self-hosted instance rewrites this to its own origin.

tags.name: meta
tags.description: Liveness and build metadata. The only routes with a stability promise.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Email-first sign-in, registration, and password reset. Cookie-based; a token cannot call these.

tags.name: api keys
tags.description: Personal access tokens — the credential for everything else, and for MCP.

tags.name: spaces
tags.description: A space is a wiki: a page tree, a member list, and a visibility.

tags.name: pages
tags.description: Pages are canonical markdown. `body` is the whole document; there is no block model.

tags.name: search
tags.description: Ranked Postgres full-text, plus semantic retrieval over embedded chunks.

tags.name: comments
tags.description: Anchored discussion threads on a page's text.

tags.name: attachments
tags.description: Files stored against a page, content-addressed and served publicly by hash.

tags.name: shares
tags.description: Unguessable share links, optionally password-gated and time-limited.

tags.name: public
tags.description: No-login read API for spaces published to the open web. GET-only.

get.description: Reports process, database, and semantic-retrieval status. `rag` reflects configuration only, not a live probe of the embedder.

503.description: Database unreachable. `status` is `degraded` and `db` carries the error.

get.description: Values are stamped in at build time. Describes the **backend** build only — the frontend bundle ships as a separate image and may be at a different commit.

built_at.description: RFC 3339. Falls back to process start time when unstamped.

get.description: Also served at `/openapi.json` on the public origin. `servers[0].url` is rewritten to the instance's own origin.

200.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 description of this instance.

post.summary: Sign in and receive a session cookie
post.description: Rate-limited to 5 attempts per minute per client IP. An account whose email is not yet confirmed is refused with `403 email_unverified`.

identifier.description: Email address or username. Preferred over `username`.

200.description: Signed in. Sets the `tela_session` cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, 30 days).

Set-Cookie.description: `tela_session=<opaque>; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=2592000` (plus `Secure` when the instance is served over HTTPS).

401.description: `unauthorized` — invalid credentials. Missing fields, unknown account, and a wrong password are one indistinguishable response.

403.description: `email_unverified` (confirm your email first) or `sso_required` (this account or domain must sign in through the identity provider).

post.description: Always succeeds, with or without a session.

get.description: **Cookie only.** `/api/auth/*` bypasses the bearer middleware, so a personal access token does not authenticate this route.

post.description: Open self-registration, when the instance allows it. Sends a confirmation email; the account cannot sign in until `verify-email` is called with the token from that link. Rate-limited to 6 per 15 minutes per client IP.

username.description: 1-64 characters. Also becomes the public handle at `/{username}`, so it may not collide with an organization slug.

201.description: Created; a confirmation email is on its way.

403.description: `registration_closed` — self-registration is disabled on this instance.

post.description: Consumes the single-use token from the confirmation link and **signs the user in**. Tokens are stored hashed; the raw value exists only in the link.

200.description: Confirmed and signed in. Sets the `tela_session` cookie.

post.description: Always answers 202 whether or not the address exists — no account enumeration. Rate-limited to 6 per 15 minutes per client IP.
Always answers 202 whether or not the address exists — no account enumeration. Rate-limited to 6 per 15 minutes per client IP.

post.summary: Set a new password from a reset token
post.description: Revokes **every** existing session for the account, and does not create a new one — sign in afterwards.

get.description: Caller's own tokens, newest first, revoked ones included. The raw token is never returned again.

post.description: The raw token is returned **once**, in `api_key.key`, and is stored only as an HMAC — it cannot be recovered. In bearer mode this route needs `admin` scope; a session works for any user. Only instance admins may mint `admin`-scoped tokens.

space_id.description: Pin the token to one space. Omit for instance-wide access.

expires_at.description: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` UTC, must be in the future. Omit for a token that never expires.

201.description: Created. `api_key.key` is the raw token — store it now.

403.description: `api_key_scope` (bearer without `admin`) or `forbidden` (only instance admins may mint `admin` tokens).

delete.description: Soft-revoke — the row survives for the audit trail. Idempotent.

get.description: Resolved through direct membership and organization or group grants alike.

post.description: The creator becomes owner. Passing `org_id` makes the space organization-owned and grants the whole organization `editor`.

org_id.description: You must be a member of the organization.

patch.summary: Rename, re-slug, describe, or publish a space
patch.description: `editor+` for name, slug, and description. **Owner only** for `visibility` — flipping to `public` makes the whole space readable with no login (see the `public` tag).

402.description: `upgrade_required` — publishing is not included in the owner's plan on this instance.

get.description: Wider than the per-page listing: it also reaches files parented to the space root, which no page lists — the ones a sync or import drops beside the tree. Capped at 500 rows.

parameters.name: parent_page_id
parameters.description: A page id to narrow to that page's files, or the literal `root` for files at the space root. Omit for the whole space.

200.description: Files. `truncated` is true when the 500-row cap was hit.

get.summary: Export a space as a zip of markdown files
get.description: One `.md` per page with canonical frontmatter, children nested in folders, attachments under `_attachments/`. The file name matches the page's sync filename, not its URL slug.
Flat by default (one level, filtered by `parent_id`), or the whole nested tree with `tree=1`. Bodies are **not** included — use `GET /api/pages/{id}` or `/api/pages/bodies`.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Direct children of this page. Omit, or pass the literal `null`, for top-level pages. Ignored when `tree=1`.

parameters.name: tree
parameters.description: `1` returns the whole space as a nested tree; each node gains a `children` array.

200.description: Pages. Nodes carry `children` only in tree mode.

400.description: `invalid_query` — `space_id` missing or malformed, or a bad `parent_id`.

post.description: `editor+` on the target space. Two server-side transforms to know about: leading YAML frontmatter in `body` is lifted into `props` (except on deck and sheet pages, whose bodies are stored verbatim), and a leading `# Heading` identical to `title` is stripped.

parent_id.description: Omit or null for a top-level page. Must live in the same space.

get.summary: Every page you can reach, across spaces
get.description: Titles and breadcrumbs only — the index behind the command palette. A space-pinned token narrows silently.

200.description: Pages, ordered by space then title.

breadcrumb.description: Ancestor titles, root first, excluding the page itself.

get.summary: Paginated page bodies for one space
get.description: The bulk-read endpoint: cursor-paginated full bodies, optionally only what changed since a timestamp. Use this to mirror a space, not a loop over `GET /api/pages/{id}`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only pages with `updated_at` after this. Format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` UTC.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page of results.

200.description: A page of bodies, ordered by id.

get.description: Returns the canonical markdown body plus how the page is exposed to the outside world.

patch.summary: Update a page's title, body, or properties
patch.description: `editor+`. A change to `title` or `body` snapshots a revision first. **`props` replaces the whole bag** — send the properties you want to keep. There is no section-level patch over REST; the `patch_page` MCP tool is the only place heading-path targeting exists.

delete.summary: Delete a page and its subtree
delete.description: `editor+`. Soft delete — the page and **all of its descendants** move to the space trash.

post.summary: Reparent, reorder, or move a page to another space
post.description: `editor+` on the source space, and on the target space when `space_id` changes. Field **presence** matters: an omitted `parent_id` leaves the parent alone, while an explicit `null` detaches the page to the top level.

position.description: 0-based index among siblings; clamped to last.

400.description: `invalid_json`, `no_fields`, `invalid_space_id`, `invalid_parent_id`, `invalid_position`, `space_not_found`, `parent_not_found`, `parent_space_mismatch`, or `cycle` (the move would make the page its own ancestor).

get.description: Sources are filtered to spaces you can read, so the same page yields different backlinks for different callers.
Canonical frontmatter plus the body — the same rendering the zip export and the WebDAV sync surface produce.
Reads stored embeddings, so unlike `/api/rag/search` it needs no live embedder and never returns 503 — but it yields an empty list for a page that has not been indexed.
**`editor+`, not viewer** — history is a stricter read than the page itself. Bodies are omitted from the list; fetch one revision to get its body.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Return revisions older than this id. Omit for the newest.

403.description: `forbidden` (not a member, or no such page) or `viewer_no_write` (editor or owner role required).

get.description: `editor+`. A revision id belonging to another page answers `404 revision_not_found`, not someone else's content.

Ranked Postgres full-text over titles and bodies, with highlighted snippets. Scoped to what you can read, plus published spaces you cannot — those come back with `public: true` and are rank-demoted. Limit is fixed at 25; there is no space filter on this route (the MCP `search` tool has both).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: An empty query returns an empty result set, not an error.

get.description: Retrieval by meaning across page sections and extracted file text. Requires an embedder to be configured on the instance; without one every call is `503 rag_disabled`. Rate-limited per account.

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: Restrict to one space. A space-pinned token overrides this.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: `hybrid` blends vector and lexical scores. Unrecognized values behave as `hybrid`.

get.description: Expands a search hit into its whole section — the cheap way to ground an answer without pulling an entire page.

404.description: `not_found` — deliberately the same answer for "no such chunk" and "you cannot read it".

get.description: **`editor+` even to read** — a viewer gets 403, not an empty list. Roots come back oldest first with their replies bucketed underneath.

parameters.name: include_resolved
parameters.description: Exactly the value `true` includes resolved threads; anything else returns open ones only.

post.summary: Start a thread or reply to one
post.description: Two shapes. A **root** comment omits `parent_id` and must carry all three anchor fields — the quoted text plus its surrounding context, which is how tela re-locates the comment after the page is edited. A **reply** sets `parent_id` to a root comment on the same page; anchors are ignored. Replies to replies are refused: threads are one level deep.

parent_id.description: The root comment being replied to.

anchor_prefix.description: Text immediately before the quoted span. Required on a root comment.

anchor_exact.description: The quoted span itself. Required and non-empty on a root comment.

anchor_suffix.description: Text immediately after the quoted span. Required on a root comment.

patch.summary: Edit a comment or resolve a thread
patch.description: Send exactly one field. `body` is an **author-only** edit; `resolved` is an `editor+` toggle and applies to **root comments only**. Setting `resolved` to the value it already holds is a 409.

400.description: `bad_request` — no fields, both fields, an over-long body, or `resolved` on a reply.

409.description: `comment_already_resolved` — the thread is already in the state you asked for.

delete.description: Author or space owner. Soft delete.

get.description: Any space role may read. `embedded` says whether the page body actually references the file.

post.summary: Upload a file to a page
post.description: `editor+`. `multipart/form-data` with one part named `file`. Default size limit 50 MiB, configurable per instance. Storage is content-addressed, so re-uploading identical bytes is cheap.

delete.summary: Detach a file from a page

put.summary: Upload bytes against a signed ticket
put.description:
Authorized by the HMAC ticket in the path, not by a session or token — so an agent can hand a file to tela without the bytes passing through its context. Single use, five-minute TTL.

The ticket is minted by the MCP tool `request_attachment_upload` and finalized by `confirm_attachment_upload`; **neither has a REST route**, so a pure-REST client should use `POST /api/pages/{id}/attachments` instead.

The request body is the raw file bytes with any content type.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The 64-character lower-case SHA-256 of the content, optionally with a cosmetic extension (`<hash>.png`). Take it from an attachment's `url`.

get.description: **Public and unauthenticated** — knowing the content hash is the authorization, which is why hashes are not enumerable and error responses never distinguish "absent" from "not yours". Immutable and cacheable for a year; supports `If-None-Match`. Only common raster image types are served `inline`; everything else, SVG included, is `attachment`.
`editor+`.

parameters.name: include_revoked
parameters.description: Exactly the value `true` includes revoked links.

post.description: `editor+`. Produces an unguessable token; the returned `url` is what you hand out. Optionally covers the page's whole subtree, sets a password, and expires.

include_descendants.description: Share the page's whole subtree, not just the page.

password.description: Gate the link behind a password.

expires_at.description: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` UTC, must be in the future.

get.summary: Every active share link you can see
get.description: The cross-space audit view: what of yours is currently reachable from the open internet, and where it points.

200.description: Active share links across accessible spaces.

patch.summary: Change a share link's scope, password, or expiry
patch.description: `editor+`. Sending any read-only field (`id`, `token`, `page_id`, `created_by`, `created_at`, `revoked_at`) is a 400 rather than a silent no-op. A revoked link cannot be edited — create a new one.

expires_at.description: `null` removes the expiry; a string must be a future `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`.

delete.description: `editor+`. Soft-revoke, so the audit trail survives. Idempotent, and immediate — the token stops resolving.

get.summary: Read a shared page by token
get.description: No account needed — the token is the credential. Missing, revoked, and expired shares all answer with an identical 404.

200.description: The share and its root page.

post.description: Sets a share-scoped cookie that the other `/api/share/{token}/*` reads require. Rate-limited to 5 attempts a minute per token and client IP.

200.description: Unlocked. Sets `tela_share_<token>`, scoped to this share's path.

400.description: `bad_request` — unparseable body, or this share has no password.

get.summary: Read a descendant page of a share
get.description: Only for shares created with `include_descendants`. A page outside the shared subtree answers 404 exactly like a missing one.

get.summary: The page tree inside a share
get.description: One entry for a single-page share; root plus descendants otherwise. Titles and structure only, no bodies.
Every space on this instance whose visibility is `public`, across all accounts.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `popular` orders by page count; anything else is most-recently-updated.

get.description: A private or non-existent space is one indistinguishable 404.

get.summary: The whole page tree of a published space
get.description: Structure plus card metadata (excerpt, reading time, cover, tags) — enough to render an index without fetching every page.

get.summary: Read a page in a published space
get.description: No login. Publishing grants read only — there is no public write path anywhere under `/api/public/`.

get.summary: A published page as raw markdown
get.description: The agent-friendly form of a public page: canonical frontmatter plus the body, no HTML to strip.

get.summary: RSS feed of a published space
get.description: The 50 most recent top-level pages, newest first.

get.summary: Sitemap of everything published on this instance
get.description: Published space front pages, every page inside them, and account home pages. Served at `/sitemap-public.xml` on the public origin.

500.description: Encoding failed. This route answers in **plain text**, not the JSON error envelope.

get.description: Resolves one namespace of users and organizations (a user wins a collision) and returns that account's published spaces and latest posts. An account with nothing published is a 404, same as an unknown handle.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The space slug within that account.

get.summary: A published space by owner handle and slug
get.description: The canonical addressing for public content: `/{handle}/{space-slug}` in the browser resolves through here.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: The file's content hash, full or the 12-character short form used in `/f/` links.

get.summary: Metadata for a shareable file link
get.description: Backs the human-facing `/f/{hash}/{name}` page. The owning `page` is included only when its space is published.

post.description: The one write a `read`-scoped token may perform — so an agent that hit a rough edge can report it without holding write access. Write-only: there is no way to read feedback back through this API.

subject.description: Derived from the first line of `body` when omitted.

context.description: Free-form. The server merges in its own source and client fields without overwriting yours.

bearerAuth.description: A personal access token: `Authorization: Bearer tela_pat_<43 chars>`. Scope `read` allows GET and HEAD only; `write` and `admin` allow any method. A token may be pinned to a single space.

sessionCookie.name: tela_session
sessionCookie.description: The browser session cookie set by `POST /api/auth/login`. HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, 30 days.

ShareToken.name: token
ShareToken.description: The unguessable share token from a share link's `url`.

Handle.name: handle
Handle.description: A username or an organization slug — one namespace, case-insensitive.

Accepted.description: Accepted. Answered identically whether or not the address exists, to prevent account enumeration.

InvalidId.description: `invalid_id` — a path parameter was not a positive integer.

Unauthorized.description: `unauthorized` — no valid credential. A malformed bearer token never falls back to the session cookie.

Forbidden.description: `forbidden` (no access, or the role is too low), `viewer_no_write`, `api_key_scope` (the token's scope forbids this method), or `api_key_space_scope` (the token is pinned to another space).

ForbiddenOrMissingPage.description: `forbidden` — **also returned when the page does not exist**, so page ids cannot be enumerated. When the page happens to live in a published space, `code` is `forbidden_public` and `public_path` points at the no-login reader. Also `api_key_scope` / `api_key_space_scope`.

NoSuchPublicSpace.description: `not_found` — no such published space. Private and non-existent are indistinguishable.

PasswordRequired.description: `password_required` — this share is password-gated; call `POST /api/share/{token}/auth` first.

QuotaExceeded.description: `quota_exceeded` — a plan limit (pages, storage) was reached.

TooLarge.description: `too_large` — the upload exceeds the instance's file size limit (50 MiB by default).

RateLimited.description: `rate_limited` — retry after the interval in the `Retry-After` header.

RagDisabled.description: `rag_disabled` — semantic retrieval is not configured on this instance.

Error.description: The error envelope for every JSON route. Branch on `code`, not on the message.

error.description: Human-readable message. Not stable — do not parse it.

public_path.description: Only with `code: forbidden_public` — where to read this page without an account.

Scope.description: `read` permits GET and HEAD; `write` and `admin` permit any method.

Visibility.description: `public` makes the entire space readable with no account, at `/{handle}/{space-slug}`.

rag.description: Whether an embedder is configured. Not a live probe.

User.description: The signed-in user. `POST /api/auth/login` populates only the identity fields; `GET /api/auth/me` fills in the rest.

email.description: Null on legacy username-only accounts, which skip the email gate.

mcp_connected.description: Whether this account has ever authenticated an MCP client.

trial.description: Present only inside the trial-notification window.

key_prefix.description: The first 8 characters after `tela_pat_`, for identifying a token you still hold.

space_id.description: Non-null when the token is pinned to one space.

key.description: The raw token, returned **once** and never recoverable — only its HMAC is stored.

my_role.description: Your effective role. Set on single-space responses, absent from listings.

public_path.description: Server-computed `/{handle}/{space-slug}`. Present only for a public space — never derive it client-side.

principals.description: Organizations and groups the space is shared with.

owner_org.description: Present when the space is organization-owned.

PageProps.description: Free-form page properties. Reserved keys are dropped. Two are load-bearing: `deck: true` makes the body a Slidev presentation, `sheet: true` makes it a spreadsheet — both are then stored verbatim, frontmatter included.

body.description: Canonical markdown. This is the whole document — tela has no block model.

Exposure.description: How far outside the space this page is readable.

state.description: `public` = reachable with no credential; `password` = reachable with a share password.

inherited.description: True when the exposure comes from an ancestor's subtree share rather than this page.

RevisionSummary.description: A history entry without its body.

source.description: What made the edit, e.g. the app, sync, or an agent.

body.description: The page body as of this revision.

snippet.description: Contains `<mark>` tags around the matched terms.

public.description: True when you can read this hit only because the space is published, not because you are a member. Such hits are rank-demoted.

id.description: `page_id` as a string. An alias for connector clients that require a string id.

text.description: Alias of `snippet`, for the same reason.

Chunk.description: An indexed section of a page, or of the extracted text of a file.

chunk_id.description: Pass to `/api/rag/chunk` to read the section in full.

page_id.description: For a file chunk, the parent page — `0` when the file sits at the space root.

title.description: Page title, or the file name for a file chunk.

heading_path.description: Where in the document this chunk sits, e.g. `Deployment > Rollback`.

anchor_prefix.description: Root comments only — the text before the quoted span.

anchor_exact.description: Root comments only — the quoted span.

anchor_suffix.description: Root comments only — the text after the quoted span.

CommentThread.description: A root comment and its replies. Threads are one level deep.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the content, 64 lower-case hex characters.

share_path.description: Relative path to the human-facing file page: `/f/{hash12}/{name}`.

embedded.description: Whether the page body references this file.

share_url.description: Absolute URL to the file page.

markdown.description: Ready-to-paste markdown that embeds or links the file.

parent_page_id.description: Absent when the file sits at the space root.

parent_title.description: Absent when the file sits at the space root.

has_password.description: The password itself is never returned.

PublicShare.description: What a share tells an anonymous reader about itself.

CardMeta.description: Index-card metadata computed from a page, so a listing can be rendered without fetching bodies.

kind.description: Absent for an ordinary prose page.

owner_handle.description: The owning organization's slug when the space is organization-owned, otherwise the owner's username.

updated_at.description: Most recent page update. Empty string when the space has no pages.

deck.description: Present only on a presentation page.

spaces.description: Published spaces, most recently active first.

posts.description: Up to 6 recent top-level public pages across those spaces.

short.description: The 12-character hash prefix used in `/f/` links.

kind.description: Coarse category driving how the file page previews it.

page.description: The page this file hangs off. Present only when that page's space is published.

source.description: Derived from the credential used: `web` for a session, `api` for a token, `mcp` for the MCP tool.
